horizon_rationale: Conservative experimental demonstration scope, not an empirically validated forecast horizon.
method_policy: Reuse original validation-selected method per series; no test-driven reselection or tuning.
fit_policy: Refit selected methods using all frozen available observations. Former evaluation records become deployment training data, never a new independent test.
quality_policy: Retain all source flags. Any flagged training observation blocks ingredient monetary conversion for that series.
publication_policy: Monthly observation keys are not independently verified publication timestamps; retrospective snapshot, not an as-of-market backtest.
budget_policy: No automatic expense adjustment, hotel/package indexation, basket weights, or adjustment of locked quotations.
